items: New Zealand bat out the final day in Wellington — the Test is drawn after India's record 720 for 9
UN talks on autonomous weapons end with no binding rules; the work runs on to 2028
The search goes on after a Nigeria boat disaster that killed at least 24 mourners
Flights are grounded across Belgium by a strike against austerity cuts
China will cut the margin requirement for leveraged share buying to 80% from 30 November
The Hang Seng slips for a fifth straight session; Shanghai edges higher
Libya's Tripoli government condemns the Benghazi strike and demands answers from Kyiv
Iran says four tankers struck mines near Hormuz — claimed, and not confirmed
Guterres says he is 'deeply disappointed' by the COP31 failure
Tokyo's markets are closed for the Labour Thanksgiving Day holiday
also_on.title: ALSO ON MONDAY

items.text: Houthi missile intercepted over Saudi Arabia
Seoul stocks slide to a 10-month low
Nepal and India sign eight agreements in New Delhi
Tehran vows to resist the US naval blockade
Zelenskyy claims the strike on a Russian corvette in Libya; the Dymer search ends
Wall Street roars back as Nvidia soars 31%

date_check: DATE CHECK — Every story on this page happened on, or was updated on, Monday 23 November 2026. Death tolls are the latest official counts at press time.
footer: Compiled from wire reports · Monday 23 November 2026

panels_large.body: The longest climate summit on record closes in Antalya without a pact, after the EU and others reject a text that never named fossil fuels. It is the first such failure since Copenhagen in 2009, and the UN chief says the science has 'no ambiguity'.
panels_large.headline: COP31 ENDS WITH NO DEAL

panels_large.body: Jensen Huang returns as chief executive 11 days after resigning, and Nvidia shares leap 31% in a day. Wall Street rebounds with it: the Nasdaq jumps about 7% after its worst week since 2020.
panels_large.headline: NVIDIA BRINGS BACK ITS FOUNDER

panels_large.body: Indonesia confirms 24 people dead in the Cikande candy factory fire, with about 30 still missing as rescuers search the ruins. Some 300 people were on shift when the blaze broke out.
panels_large.headline: 24 DEAD IN INDONESIA FACTORY FIRE

panels_small.body: A Russian drone collapses part of a five-storey building in Dymer. The search ends with 11 dead; a boy of 7 is pulled out alive after 14 hours.
panels_small.headline: 11 DEAD IN KYIV APARTMENT STRIKE

panels_small.body: After Iran's strike on a civilian facility, Bahrain asks the Security Council to enforce its Resolution 2817. A Houthi missile aimed at Saudi Arabia is intercepted.
panels_small.headline: BAHRAIN DEMANDS UN ACTION

panels_small.body: Sea drones partly sink the corvette Merkury at Benghazi. Zelenskyy claims the strike and releases footage; ten people are reported injured.
panels_small.headline: UKRAINE SINKS RUSSIAN CORVETTE IN LIBYA

panels_small.body: Tehran calls the blockade an act of aggression and claims four tankers struck mines near Hormuz — a claim no maritime authority has confirmed.
panels_small.headline: IRAN VOWS TO RESIST US BLOCKADE

panels_small.body: The Kospi closes 3.3% lower at a 10-month low while Taiwan climbs 2.2%. Tokyo is shut for a holiday; governments pledge market support.
panels_small.headline: SEOUL TUMBLES AS ASIA SPLITS

panels_small.body: After a $2.5bn liquidation washout drove it to $55,130 on Saturday, bitcoin trades back near $61,500.
panels_small.headline: BITCOIN BOUNCES OFF A TWO-YEAR LOW

panels_small.body: The Supreme Court applies the amnesty law and closes the 2017 'procés' case, clearing the Catalan leader's return from exile in Belgium.
panels_small.headline: SPAIN CLOSES THE BOOK ON PUIGDEMONT

panels_small.body: Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin resigns, taking responsibility for the chaotic last-minute anti-cheating measures around the Suneung exam.
panels_small.headline: SOUTH KOREA MINISTER QUITS OVER AI CHEATING

panels_small.body: Balendra Shah's state visit closes with talks with Modi, eight agreements, and an Indian offshore campus announced for Nepal.
panels_small.headline: NEPAL'S PM SEALS EIGHT DEALS IN DELHI

panels_small.body: The cargo ship Sparta II, set ablaze by drones in the Baltic on Saturday, arrives under tow with all 16 crew safe.
panels_small.headline: RUSSIAN SHIP TOWED HOME TO ST PETERSBURG
